name: 且邀春风斩棘行
overview: Jiang Yanxue is transported into a novel as a notorious villainess destined to die for her obsession with the crown prince. After failed attempts to change her fate, she embraces the role of the “evil woman,” joining forces with a mysterious power broker to seek revenge. Using modern knowledge to amass wealth and undermine royal power, she exposes hidden truths, stages a fake romance with a charming nobleman, and fights to reclaim control of her destiny.
